name: resume-copilot
description: ATS resume analysis platform with 100-point scoring, skill extraction, role matching, and actionable resume recommendations.

paragraphs: Fast, private, and deterministic ATS resume diagnostics. Evaluates resume PDFs against industry Applicant Tracking System criteria, calculates a transparent 100-point score, validates clickable contact and project hyperlinks, matches relevant job roles, and provides prioritized, actionable improvements.
features: 100-Point Explainable ATS Scoring: Transparent evaluation across 4 core pillars with real-time verdicts (ATS Ready, Needs Optimization, Not ATS Friendly).
Deep Hyperlink Extraction: Identifies and verifies clickable links (LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, project demos) directly from PDF annotation layers.
Integrity & Typo Guardian: Detects common email domain typos (such as @gmai.com), verifies international phone dial codes (+), and flags template placeholder URLs (yourname).
Target Role Matching: Matches extracted candidate skills against 100+ industry job profiles (from data/jobs.csv), displaying fit percentage and missing keywords.
Skill & Keyword Extraction: Extracts technical tools, programming languages, libraries, and core professional competencies using comprehensive keyword mapping.
